items.title: DevFest is back!
items.content: DevFest 2026 runs from October 1 to December 31, bringing together nearly a million developers across more than 800 global events centered on the agentic AI era. Under the theme "Build, Secure, Scale," participants gain hands-on experience with Google’s developer stack—including Gemini, Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity, and Web MCP—through live workshops and codelabs. The conference focuses on enabling developers to prototype rapidly, ensure secure and private deployments, and leverage production-ready infrastructure.

summaries.zh: DevFest 2026将于10月1日至12月31日举办，汇集全球800多场活动，吸引近百万开发者，聚焦智能代理AI时代。主题为“构建、安全、扩展”，参与者将通过实战工作坊和代码实验室体验谷歌开发者工具栈（包括Gemini、Google AI Studio等）。会议旨在帮助开发者快速原型设计、确保安全部署并利用成熟基础设施。

items.title: Build Generative UI Apps with A2UI & CopilotKit Agents
items.content: See Google A2Ui in action! Learn how to natively render agentic UIs across Langchain, AWS Strands, Microsoft agents, and Google ADK using CopilotKit SDKs for A2UI.

items.title: Hill-Climbing Agent Quality with Agents CLI Evaluation
items.content: This post walks through the Agents CLI evaluation loop for systematically improving agent performance through continuous testing and grading. It demonstrates how to catch prompt regressions, evaluate model backend swaps using side-by-side trace comparisons, and automate evaluation passes. Developers will also learn how to integrate nightly scheduled runs with threshold-based alerting to track quality over time.

items.title: Smaller apps and faster GPU inference with LiteRT in Google Play services
items.content: LiteRT in Google Play services now offers GPU inference powered by ML Drift, delivering about 1.4x faster performance alongside the new CompiledModel API. Switching from bundled binaries reduces app size by approximately 8 MB while enabling seamless, automatic runtime updates across billions of devices. Developers can easily adopt these updates by updating their dependencies and utilizing the new Android Studio LiteRT skill for automated migration.

items.title: Fast, reliable A2UI, with swappable inference formats
items.content: A2UI now supports swappable inference formats, introducing A2UI Express which uses up to 3x fewer tokens and cuts latency by compiling compact Python-style syntax into standard A2UI JSON via Agent SDKs. Developers can also use controlled generation with TypeSafe's Jev system-decision models to render known-shape screens in under 300 ms while smaller models stream text. These updates require no changes to frontend renderers or component catalogs, offering flexible performance levers for generative UI development across Python, TypeScript, and Dart.

These updates require no changes to frontend renderers or component catalogs, offering flexible performance levers for generative UI development across Python, TypeScript, and Dart.

items.title: Preview, edit, and collaborate on markdown (.md) files natively in Google Docs and Drive
items.content: Google Workspace now offers native support for Markdown (.md) files, allowing developers and AI agents to seamlessly collaborate on documentation directly in Google Docs without manual file conversions. This integration preserves native file fidelity for use with Git repositories and developer tools while unlocking standard Docs features like line-level commenting, rendered Drive previews, and tracked version history.

items.title: Streaming comes to API Gateway: real-time and AI-ready APIs, without changing your spec
items.content: API Gateway now supports real-time streaming—including Server-Sent Events, WebSockets, gRPC, and chunked transfer encoding—in Public Preview without requiring changes to your existing API specifications. This update allows developers to route long-lived, bi-directional streams and AI workloads directly through the gateway while maintaining consistent authentication, rate limiting, and observability. Additionally, gateways now feature deterministic default hostnames, simplifying environment provisioning and infrastructure-as-code management.

Additionally, gateways now feature deterministic default hostnames, simplifying environment provisioning and infrastructure-as-code management.

summaries.zh: API网关现已支持实时流，包括Server-Sent Events、WebSockets、gRPC和分块传输编码，无需修改现有API规范。此次更新允许开发者通过网关路由长寿命双向流和AI工作负载，同时保持一致的认证、速率限制和可观察性。此外，网关新增确定性默认主机名，简化了环境部署和基础设施即代码管理。

The update also introduces deterministic default hostnames, simplifying environment provisioning and infrastructure-as-code management.

items.title: Architecting Governed, Self-Evolving AI Agents on Google Cloud
items.content: Learn how Project Chrysalis combines Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Development Kit (ADK), BigQuery, and a four-gate defense-in-depth security stack (Model Armor, Cloud KMS, Binary Authorization, and OPA) to build governed, self-evolving AI agents that remediate live production outages in 1.8 seconds.

items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了如何利用Google Cloud的Gemini企业代理平台、代理开发工具包（ADK）、BigQuery及四层纵深防御安全体系（模型防护、云KMS、二进制授权和OPA）构建受监管、可自进化的AI代理。该项目名为Chrysalis，通过这些技术实现AI代理在1.8秒内自动修复生产环境故障。
summaries.en: Project Chrysalis integrates Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Development Kit (ADK), BigQuery, and a four-layer security framework (Model Armor, Cloud KMS, Binary Authorization, OPA) to create governed, self-evolving AI agents. These agents can resolve live production outages in 1.8 seconds. The system leverages these tools to ensure secure, efficient, and autonomous AI operations.

items.title: Powering the Agent Development Lifecycle with any framework, from ADK to LangChain and beyond
items.content: The Agents CLI Extension System enables developers to use frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or custom enterprise stacks while retaining a unified deployment and evaluation workflow. It details a first-party LangChain template that scaffolds, runs, and deploys agents without requiring the Agent Development Kit (ADK). Additionally, it demonstrates how platform teams can author custom extensions to enforce policies such as automated software bill of materials (SBOM) scans during deployment.

Additionally, it demonstrates how platform teams can author custom extensions to enforce policies such as automated software bill of materials (SBOM) scans during deployment.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了 Agents CLI 扩展系统，该系统支持开发者使用 LangChain、LangGraph 等框架或自定义企业堆栈，同时保持统一的部署和评估流程。文章详细说明了一个官方 LangChain 模板，该模板可搭建、运行和部署代理，无需依赖 Agent Development Kit (ADK)。此外，还展示了平台团队如何编写自定义扩展，以在部署期间强制执行自动化软件物料清单 (SBOM) 扫描等策略。
summaries.en: The Agents CLI Extension System allows developers to use frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or custom enterprise stacks while maintaining a unified deployment and evaluation workflow. It introduces a first-party LangChain template that simplifies agent scaffolding, running, and deployment without requiring the Agent Development Kit (ADK). The system also enables platform teams to create custom extensions for policies, such as automated software bill of materials (SBOM) scans during deployment. This approach enhances flexibility and integration across diverse agent development environments.
